products.name: PeepalRP
products.tagline: One system to run your institution.
products.summary: An all-in-one, multi-tenant ERP for hospitals and colleges. Every department works from one realtime platform, and billing and inventory follow a single traceable chain: item masters, vendors, purchase orders, dispatch to the patient, pending charges, bills and payments.
features: One platform for every department, so nothing falls through the gaps
Every rupee tracked from purchase to payment, with a clear audit trail
Faster journeys for the people you serve, from first appointment to final bill
GST-ready bills that cut errors and speed up collections
Recurring charges added automatically, so nothing goes unbilled
Live updates for every team, so everyone works from the same facts
Stock you can trust, with less wastage and fewer stockouts
Multi-tenant by design, so each organization gets its own secure, separate workspace
